name: daily-driver
notes: Ratified T2 by the owner on 2026-09-27. Public static CV and portfolio on GitHub Pages: every push to main is live, with no staging, accounts, payments or server-side data. The site loads the Pulseboard SDK (usage plan v2), which sends consented aggregate counts and product events to Pulseboard's collector; the collector, not this repository, holds that data. Push and merge are free within the global proving, review and aging gates; verify the rendered page before merging because main deploys directly. Reassess before adding accounts, forms that store personal data, or any server-side component.
